description: This file contains shell functions and scripts related to platform-specific upgrade procedures, including device detection, image validation, firmware/partition writing, and configuration copying for embedded devices.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Detects and exports the boot device based on root partition UUID.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates whether the image's partition layout matches the current device.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade by writing the image to the appropriate device and partitions.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files to the boot partition of the device.
